code-reviewer and security-reviewer in parallel, then the simplifier

R1 CR-01 and SEC-01 the same escape fix · the simplifier changed nothing
left open after round 3, all minor

the app-launch screenshot shows the capture server as root
any decoded path segment becomes the page crumb, no limit
